original_prompt: Generate a QR code for http://localhost/Ar_Food_Menu/index.php
enhanced_prompt:
Generate a professional, high-contrast QR code that encodes the URL "http://localhost/Ar_Food_Menu/index.php". The QR code should be:
- Perfect square format (1:1 aspect ratio)
- High contrast with black modules on white background
- Bold, thick modules for easy scanning
- No text or logos inside the QR code
- Clean, minimalist design
- Suitable for printing and mobile scanning
- Professional appearance for a restaurant AR food menu application
- Size: 1024x1024 pixels
